purpose: Official public references for version-sensitive customization features; not a guarantee that a particular account or client enables them.

sources.note: Repository-wide and matching path-specific instructions combine; feature support varies by Copilot surface.
.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md uses name and description frontmatter. No shell auto-approval is configured by this lab. gh skill is documented as public preview; this lab does not require it.

At verification time, prompt files remain supported by Local agent but are deprecated/not loaded in Agent Host sessions. The documented prompt-to-skill migration is experimental. If unavailable, explicitly paste the prompt text; do not claim it was loaded.

.vscode/mcp.json with servers/type/command/args/cwd is supported; current docs prefer portable .mcp.json for new configurations. This lab intentionally provides the requested VS Code compatibility format. Review and start on demand; no auto-start task is supplied.
Trust is a user action. The Agent Customizations editor is labeled Preview. This lab neither grants trust nor changes global permissions.

The required @modelcontextprotocol/sdk package is the v1 maintenance line, implementing MCP through 2025-11-25. Do not present it as the current v2 SDK or claim newer protocol features. Exact npm package versions are pinned and locked.

modelPolicy: No model ID is pinned and no model availability, price, quota or BYOK eligibility is promised. Verify the current client/account/provider UI and official documentation during the demo.
pluginPolicy: No plugin manifest is supplied and no plugin installation is claimed. The repository quality-gate skill is the portable teaching artifact.
